Description: Shaft outer diameter measured by micrometer
Rationale: Has true zero (0 mm) and infinitely divisible decimal measurement.

Description: Part weight weighed on digital balance
Rationale: Continuous weight measurement with true zero.

Description: Visual inspection result (Pass / Fail)
Rationale: Classification label with no numerical order.

Description: Tightening torque of M8 bolt
Rationale: Measured continuously on a torque wrench/transducer.

Description: Number of burrs counted per bracket
Rationale: Integer count of defects (0 means zero defects).

Description: Furnace zone temperature in Celsius
Rationale: Continuous scale; 0 °C is arbitrary (not absence of thermal energy).

Description: Cosmetic rating grade (Poor / Fair / Good / Excellent)
Rationale: Ordered ranking categories without equal intervals between ranks.

Description: Solder joint defect type code (Bridge / Void / Tombstone)
Rationale: Named defect categories with no inherent order.

Description: Cycle time per part on CNC Lathe
Rationale: Time duration with true zero and continuous resolution.

Description: Number of missing labels per pallet
Rationale: Discrete count of nonconforming items/events.

Description: Mold cavity ID number (Cavity 1 / Cavity 2 / Cavity 3 / Cavity 4)
Rationale: Numbers act purely as labels/identifiers; averaging Cavity ID is meaningless.

Description: Surface roughness Ra value
Rationale: Continuous physical measurement with true zero.

Description: Customer satisfaction score (1 to 5 Stars)
Rationale: Ordered rating scale; difference between 1-2 and 4-5 stars is not guaranteed equal.

Description: Shift code (Day / Night)
Rationale: Categorical grouping variable without order.

Description: Sheet metal thickness
Rationale: Continuous physical dimension measurement.

Description: Number of rejected lots per month
Rationale: Discrete integer count per period.

Description: Ambient storage temperature in Fahrenheit
Rationale: Interval scale; ratio comparison like 80°F is twice as hot as 40°F is invalid.

Description: Go / No-Go plug gauge check result
Rationale: Binary attribute classification even though underlying feature is dimensional.

Description: Leak test pressure drop
Rationale: Continuous pressure measurement with true zero.

Description: Operator skill level (Level 1 Trainee / Level 2 Certified / Level 3 Trainer)
Rationale: Ordered hierarchy of skill levels without equal numerical distance.
